note.kid: Each box on the way takes off this envelope and puts on a new one for the next cable.
note.nerd: Link-local only: a new frame with new MAC addresses is written for every hop.

dst.about: The next box on this cable. Every router writes a new frame for the next link.

src.about: The box that put this frame on the cable. Switches and access points pass it on unchanged.

type.name: EtherType
type.about: What is inside: 0x0800 IPv4, 0x88A8 VLAN tags, 0x8847 MPLS.

fcs.name: Frame check sequence
fcs.about: A CRC over the whole frame: a damaged frame is dropped.
